name: Ruai
source:
A merchant plying the seas around the archipelago and trades with pirates and lords alike without prejudice, she is very capable of defending herself against any pirate who wishes to take advantage of her.

Her connections with the Marsteria navy give her formidable backing even if a pirate were to best her and her crew in combat.
